[Trend Position]
· Current price (73,165 KRW) below SMA5 (76,276 KRW), SMA20 (82,366 KRW), SMA50 (93,335 KRW): short- to mid-term trend diagnosed as weak.
· Below SMA100 (100,601 KRW) and SMA200 (101,113 KRW): long-term trend strength confirmed weak.
· 52-week position (19.2%) + current price range historically low.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (36.5→35.2): confirmed entry into oversold territory.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-113.4659→-178.0628): continued worsening, diagnosed as bearish convergence.
· Bollinger Band current price position (near lower band 70,508 KRW): approaching lower band.
[Support & Resistance]
· Swing support (72,060 KRW): based on Pivot S1 and 20-day low.
· Swing resistance (86,590 KRW): short-term rebound expected on breakout.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (sideways): confirmed lack of directional trend.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.40x): confidence in movement is weak.
· Current phase diagnosis (accumulation phase): entry contingent on RSI exiting oversold and MACD improving.
